description: A React component that implements an error boundary to catch JavaScript errors in child components, prevent the app from crashing, and display a fallback UI with options to reload or dismiss the error.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that extends React.Component to catch errors in its child components, manage error state, and render fallback UI when an error occurs.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: A static React lifecycle method that updates the component's state when an error is thrown.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: A React lifecycle method that logs error details to the console when an error is caught within child components.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the fallback UI when an error is present or the child components otherwise.
